description: Hyperscaler capex guidance moved UP through July 2026 earnings, directly contradicting the 2026-06-05 'AI capex peak scare' (cat_20260605_ai_capex_peak_scare) narrative of a demand air-pocket. Alphabet raised FY2026 capex guidance to $195-205bn (from $180-190bn prior quarter). The Big Four hyperscalers (Amazon, Google, Meta, Microsoft) now guide to combined FY2026 capex of up to $630bn, +62% YoY vs $388bn in 2025 (Amazon ~$200bn, Microsoft $110-120bn, Meta $115-135bn). TSMC's 2026-07-16 earnings call added a further $100bn to its Arizona buildout (total planned US investment $265bn), citing AI demand still scaling. Net read: the June guidance-miss scare that triggered a selloff and a 'contested' regime_state on struct_ai_capex_supercycle has not been confirmed by subsequent hard data -- capex commitments broadened and accelerated instead of decelerating.
